title: Mexican Suet Biryani Casserole
description: A unique twist on traditional Mexican dishes, incorporating the savory flavor of suet and the spices of biryani.
instructions: Cook biriyani rice according to package instructions.
In a large pan, cook ground beef until browned.
Add diced onion, chili powder, and cumin to the pan and cook until onion is translucent.
Stir in tomato sauce and coconut milk. Bring to a simmer.
In a separate pan, melt suet over medium heat. Add diced Thai chili and cook until fragrant.
In a large casserole dish, combine cooked rice, beef mixture, and suet mixture. Mix well.
Transfer the casserole to the preheated oven and bake for 25-30 minutes.
Remove from oven and let it rest for 5 minutes before serving.
